name: STM32F446RE
description: STMicroelectronics STM32F446RE: an Arm Cortex-M4F at up to 180 MHz with an MPU, 512 KiB of flash and 128 KiB of SRAM, in an LQFP64; the NUCLEO-F446RE's MCU.

memory.name: flash
memory.doc: Main memory: sectors 0-3 of 16 KiB, 4 of 64 KiB, 5-7 of 128 KiB

memory.name: flash_alias
memory.doc: Boot alias of the main flash when BOOT0 is low

memory.name: sram
memory.doc: SRAM1 (112 KiB) and SRAM2 (16 KiB), contiguous

memory.name: otp
memory.doc: One-time programmable area: 512 bytes and 16 lock bytes

sources.name: hsi
sources.doc: Internal 16 MHz RC, the clock out of reset

sources.name: hse
sources.doc: External crystal 4 to 26 MHz, or an external clock up to 50 MHz (bypass)

functional.claims: Cortex-M4F instruction execution (Thumb-2 with ARMv7E-M's DSP instructions, FPv4-SP, NVIC with 4 priority bits, SCB, SysTick, DWT, the MPU with eight regions, lazy floating-point context stacking, semihosting); every register of ST's STM32F446 SVD at its address with its reset value and access type, corrected where RM0390 differs (the corrections are listed in registers.json).
omissions: every peripheral model: RCC, FLASH, PWR, GPIO, SYSCFG, EXTI, the timers, USART and UART, DMA, ADC, DAC, SPI, I2C, the watchdogs and the RTC keep their register values and raise mcu.unsupported_access until their models land (docs/engineering/rtos-boards.md, steps 3 to 8)
CAN, SDIO, QUADSPI, SAI, SPDIF-RX, HDMI-CEC, DCMI, FMC, FMPI2C and the USB OTG controllers
flash programming and the option bytes' effects

timed.claims: Instruction timing is estimated from EmbCC's per-class cost table with the taken-branch refill (ADR-015), not cycle-exact.
omissions: flash wait states and the ART accelerator

electrical.claims: GPIO pin-model defaults at 3.3 V: VIH 0.45 VDD + 0.3, VIL 0.3 VDD, 40 kOhm pull resistors, VOL 0.4 V at 8 mA; output resistance and slew estimated per OSPEEDR setting from the datasheet's maximum frequencies.
omissions: 5 V tolerance of the FT pins and the absolute maximum ratings

sources.title: RM0390 Reference manual: STM32F446xx advanced Arm-based 32-bit MCUs
PM0214 Programming manual: STM32 Cortex-M4 MCUs and MPUs
